name: io.github.j0hanz/filesystem-mcp
title: Filesystem MCP
description: Secure filesystem MCP server for reading, writing, searching, diffing, and patching files.

packageArguments.description: Optional root directory path the MCP server is allowed to access. If omitted, roots can be provided by the MCP Roots protocol or --allow-cwd.

packageArguments.name: --allow-cwd
packageArguments.description: Allow the current working directory as an additional root.

packageArguments.name: --port
packageArguments.description: Enable HTTP transport on the given port (Node Streamable HTTP).

runtimeArguments.name: -i
runtimeArguments.description: Keep stdin open for stdio transport.

packageArguments.description: Root directory path inside the container the server is allowed to access.

packageArguments.name: --allow-cwd
packageArguments.description: Allow the container working directory as an additional root.

packageArguments.name: --port
packageArguments.description: Enable HTTP transport on the given port (Node Streamable HTTP).
